cta.picker: Or look around a demo event first

exit.message: The demo event, its shifts and everything you booked in it are deleted straight away. None of it can be brought back.
exit.title: End the demo?

expired.message: Demo events only live for an hour, and yours has just been deleted along with everything in it. You can look around a fresh one, or make a real account and keep what you plan.
expired.title: Your demo has ended

helper.description: Book yourself into shifts, say when you are free, and see what you have signed up for.
helper.title: As a helper

startDialog.intro: We will set up an example event for you — tasks, shifts, a few teammates — and take you straight to it. Nothing in it is real, and the whole thing is deleted again after an hour.

manager.description: Plan the tasks and shifts, see which places are still open, and handle invitations and requests to join.
manager.title: As an organiser

startDialog.question: Which side would you like to see?
startDialog.signedInWarning: Starting the demo signs you out of your account. Your own events are untouched — sign back in whenever you like.
startDialog.title: Look around a demo event
